External deposit awaiting confirmation. Emitted during the external-deposit
lifecycle (funds arriving from outside CrowdSplit, e.g., a bank wire or
on-chain transfer to a virtual account). Payload is a
`WebhookTransactionData` with `type: external_deposit`; reconcile against
bank or on-chain records.
